findings.text: the rendered mirror job's output directive names the state log directory but, unlike the three tracked batch scripts (scripts/spine_label_fleet.sh:7) and scripts/temporal_operator_cycle.sh:10, it carries no comment that the directory must exist before submission, and that script is submitted by hand, so a hand submission on a host without ~/.local/state/ambix/slurm-logs fails the same way the tracked-script comments were added to prevent.

slurm_log_path is the only way the code creates the directory, called with an empty output name at slurm.py:1268, cli.py:4536 and cli.py:4544, so a resolver of an output name doubles as a directory preparer and the meaning of the empty argument is not evident from the call.

the tracked-script assertion compares output[0].parent against Path.home()/'.local/state/ambix/slurm-logs' while scripts/spine_label_fleet.sh:8 hard-codes /home/ITER/mcintos/..., so the guard reddens on any host whose HOME differs, for a reason unrelated to the regression it guards.
